subject: اللغة الإنجليزية
lesson: Unit 3 – Lesson 5: Vocabulary and Grammar – Parts of buildings and the Past continuous
outcomes: I can name parts of buildings like ceiling, corridor and lift.
I can use the Past continuous (was/were + -ing) with the Past simple.
I can talk about my early memories.

tf.s: The ceiling is above your head in a room.
tf.why: The ceiling is the top of a room; the floor is under your feet.

tf.s: An escalator is a set of moving stairs.
tf.why: An escalator moves you up or down.

tf.s: You go out of a building through the entrance.
tf.why: You go out through the exit; you go in through the entrance.

tf.s: The Past continuous is was/were + verb-ing.
tf.why: For example: The guide was talking.

tf.s: In the Past continuous, we say “They was watching TV.”
tf.why: With they we use were: They were watching TV.

tf.s: A shorter action can happen in the middle of a longer action.
tf.why: I was watching TV (longer) when my friend called (shorter).

tf.s: A corridor is the top part of a building, like a roof.
tf.why: A corridor is a long passage with rooms on each side.

tf.s: In “Eddie was touching a bookcase when he fell”, “he fell” is the longer action.
tf.why: Was touching a bookcase is the longer action; he fell is shorter.

tf.s: A lift takes you up to another floor and uses electricity.
tf.why: You press a button and the lift goes up or down.

tf.s: “What were you doing at 8 o’clock last night?” is a correct question.
tf.why: Question form: What + were + you + doing?

boxes.q: What is above your head in a room?
You go out of a building through the…
boxes.why: The exit is the way out.

boxes.q: Complete: The guide ___ (talk) when they walked through the entrance.
boxes.why: The guide is singular: was talking.

boxes.q: Complete: We ___ (visit) a castle when it started to rain.
Complete: They ___ watching TV when Mum came home.
Complete: We live on the second ___ of the apartment building.
boxes.why: We say on the second floor.

boxes.q: Which places did the four children talk about?
boxes.why: They talked about a school, a house, a castle and a skyscraper.

boxes.q: Which part of a building is on the very top, outside?
boxes.why: The roof covers the top of a building.
A corner is where two walls meet.

hunt.q: Above your head in a room

mcq.q: Which group is all parts of buildings?
mcq.why: These are parts of a building.

mcq.q: “You use this to go up a floor. It uses electricity.” What is it?
mcq.why: A lift (or an escalator) uses electricity to take you up.

o: A shorter action happens in the middle of a longer action.
The longer action always uses the Past simple.
We never use when with the Past continuous.
The Past continuous is did + verb.

mcq.q: Which building words are in the mystery story?
mcq.why: Eddie’s story has an entrance, stairs, a corridor and a tower.

mcq.q: Make a question: What / you / do / at 8 o’clock last night?
o: What were you doing at 8 o’clock last night?
What was you doing at 8 o’clock last night?
What you were doing at 8 o’clock last night?
What did you doing at 8 o’clock last night?
I was playing in the garden when my father called me.
I were playing in the garden when my father called me.
I was play in the garden when my father called me.
I playing in the garden when my father was call me.
mcq.why: I was + -ing for the longer action; called for the shorter one.

mcq.q: “Were you sleeping when I called?” Choose the short answer.
mcq.why: With I we use was: Yes, I was.

mcq.q: “Eddie was touching a bookcase when he fell.” Which action is longer?
mcq.why: The Past continuous shows the longer action.

o: My sisters was waiting outside the shop.
My sisters were waiting outside the shop.
My brother was waiting outside the shop.
We were waiting outside the shop.
mcq.why: My sisters is plural, so we need were.

mcq.q: What is the difference between steps and an escalator?
o: An escalator moves; steps don’t move.
Steps use electricity; an escalator doesn’t.
